privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This page explains — in plain language — what this portfolio collects and what it doesn't.
privacy.s1Body: This portfolio records aggregate page-view counts only — day, path, and language — with no identifiers, no cookies, and no third-party tools. When you send a message through the contact form, your details (name, email and message) are stored only to reply to you, and are never shared with third parties.
privacy.s2Body: The site only uses your browser's local storage to remember preferences (language, theme, and hiding the sample-content banner). The page-view counting described above runs without cookies and never follows an individual visitor — it works like a fully anonymized visit log.
privacy.s3Body: No clinical case is published without the patient's written consent and removal of any identifying features. Current photos are samples from freely-licensed sources (see the Credits page).
privacy.s4Body: You can ask for your message or data to be deleted at any time through the contact form or direct email, and I'll respond within a reasonable timeframe.
privacy.s5Body: For any question about this policy, reach me via the contact page.
